title: Chicken shawarma bowls
ingredients: 2 lb bone-in or boneless chicken thighs
1 cup yogurt mixed with 2 tbsp tahini, lemon, and salt
steps: Mix oil, spices, garlic, lemon, and salt. Coat chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Roast at 425°F until browned and cooked through, 25–35 minutes. Slice.
Serve over rice with tahini yogurt, vegetables, herbs, and pita.
